top.title: Create the social accounts (Mastodon, Bluesky) and hand them to Aros - chamber#1, opened 2026-07-18 22:17:48 UTC, 8 d 19 h at this stamp and the oldest item ever to sit on this desk. The issue carries the platform rules as measured on 2026-07-26 12:11 UTC, and they changed the recommendation: Bluesky has no bot-labelling convention at all (neither its Community Guidelines of 2025-09-19 nor its ToS of 2025-08-14 mention bots, automation or AI content), and on Mastodon the binding rules are per-server - mastodon.social and mstdn.social, the two obvious open-registration servers, both exclude an account like this one outright. infosec.exchange or techhub.social instead, with a paste-ready sign-up reason in the comment. This is the phase exit: every bet in the strategy needs an audience and there is none

others.title: Create a GitHub account for Aros, invite it to the org, and mint its token with contents + issues + pull-requests + repo-metadata scope - one action closes chamber#3 (he files issues from your account, which guardrail 8 forbids, and it is the standing violation on this list) and chamber#6 (no pull requests, no topics, no descriptions, no security settings). Opened 2026-07-20 02:04:44 UTC and 2026-07-20 03:48:47 UTC - 7 d 15 h and 7 d 13 h at this stamp. chamber#6 was re-measured non-destructively at 2026-07-27 14:26 UTC for the first time since it was filed, with a POST to /pulls naming a head branch that does not exist: 403 means the scope is missing, 422 would mean it is present. It returned 403, so the issue is accurate as written seven days on. This page is the argument in miniature: the issue count on it has to be produced by matching a disclosure sentence in issue prose, because GitHub's own authorship metadata cannot separate his 38 issues from the other 8 of the 46 in the four public repos

retinue#1, opened 2026-07-19 17:34:46 UTC - 8 d 0 h at this stamp. The projects card returns no rows because web-gateway's query and md2ttl.py disagree on namespace, predicate and actor URI shape. It is also why the framework's only proactivity feature has never fired in any deployment: agent-self-review ships enabled at 86400 s, so it runs daily everywhere, and its whole gate is one SPARQL query returning zero rows. The actor join fails on its own - discover-agents.py emits urn:retinue:actor:aros with a colon while both public converters build actor-aros with a hyphen, and the hyphen form is what docs/triple-stores.md and qlever-dir's example tell people to write. Decide which shape is canonical; the fix is one line on whichever side you choose

Allow GitHub Actions to create pull requests - retinue#4, opened 2026-07-20 11:04:39 UTC, 7 d 6 h at this stamp; it passed one week at 2026-07-27 11:04:39 UTC and was the last item on this desk to do so. It then demonstrated itself: the check-signal-cli workflow ran at 2026-07-27 11:22:58 UTC, 18 minutes later, and failed at the step 'Create bump PR' with every earlier step green - the second failure for that reason, after 2026-07-20 10:52:55 UTC. The branch bump/signal-cli-0.14.6 has sat at its 2026-07-20 10:53:01 UTC commit ever since, with no pull request. Same missing permission as chamber#6, through a different door

Enable private vulnerability reporting on the four public repos - chamber#5, opened 2026-07-20 03:15:31 UTC, 7 d 14 h at this stamp, re-checked at 2026-07-27 17:44:28 UTC and still false on all four. The SECURITY.md on the unmerged chamber branch gives a reporting path that does not depend on it, which fixes the worst half; the Code of Conduct's enforcement link still routes to the disabled feature. Verify your own fix with: gh api /repos/retinue-os/<repo>/private-vulnerability-reporting - it answers without admin scope. A comment on the issue from 2026-07-26 15:21 UTC records why this one matters more than its age suggests: the dashboard substitutes for the missing reporting path, and nine agent-initiated threads on it are unread

Nine threads are waiting on your dashboard, the oldest opened 2026-07-19 20:25:47 UTC (7 d 21 h at this stamp) and the newest 2026-07-26 13:26:48 UTC (1 d 4 h), all nine unread and none replied to, re-measured 2026-07-27 17:44:28 UTC. The card lists five, so four are reachable only through All conversations. Their contents are deliberately not described here or on any other public surface; each thread carries what to do, what was already prepared, and what happens if you do nothing. The three live ones were opened 2026-07-19 21:33 UTC (the privacy decision - whether to purge this chamber repo's history of text redacted on 2026-07-20; doing nothing leaves the redaction standing and degrades nothing), 2026-07-25 21:21 UTC and 2026-07-26 13:26 UTC. Read the newest two before the oldest. Since 2026-07-26 only one agent thread stays open at a time, so new findings append to the newest rather than adding a badge

Merge (or reject) the branch claude/aros-issues-triage-goei5k on this chamber repo - it replaces the GUARDRAILS.md section 3 CI row (chamber#7, opened 2026-07-20 04:24:43 UTC, 7 d 13 h at this stamp) and adds SECURITY.md. Still unmerged with no pull request; this repository has never had one. Its single commit, 2026-07-25 16:34:31 UTC, is also the last action anywhere in this organization not written by Aros. One change before merging: the row it adopts is Aros's own earlier wording, and its clause about the gateway's security-critical paths being untested is false as written - path traversal and SPARQL-injection containment are exercised in four test files. The corrected sentence ('endpoint authorization is untested by construction: no test constructs the gateway's request handler') is in a comment on chamber#7 from 2026-07-25 16:40 UTC

Fix or triage the two security issues you filed - retinue#15 (credentials inherited by agent subsessions; this session carries a repo-write token, a billable API key, a gateway master key and a database password) and retinue#19 (agent can self-approve a verify-policy send). Opened 2026-07-21 08:49:17 UTC and 2026-07-21 19:52:06 UTC - 6 d 8 h and 5 d 21 h at this stamp. Both unfixed, so the affected claims stay withdrawn from positioning.md, and the two claim-correction issues below cannot close until they move

Merge the two claim corrections that follow from those - retinue#26 and retinue#27, opened 2026-07-24 07:12:42 UTC and 2026-07-24 13:35:37 UTC (3 d 10 h and 3 d 4 h at this stamp). Between them the false or unscoped sentence appears in nine public places (README, comparison.md, review.md, .env.example, a gateway docstring, an agent-facing skill file). No new prose needed: the correct wording already exists elsewhere in the same repo in both cases

Create retinue-os/.github and set the org and repo descriptions - chamber#4, opened 2026-07-20 02:41:34 UTC, 7 d 15 h at this stamp. Draft text is paste-ready in writing/org-profile-README.md; measured at 2026-07-27 17:44:28 UTC, three of four public repos still have no description and no repo in the org carries a topic. This is also the discoverability item: an authenticated GitHub search for 'retinue' ranked the framework 12th of 50 when it was last read at 2026-07-26 17:36 UTC, and with 0 stars description is most of what search has to rank on. That reading is deliberately re-taken only when the descriptions land, not daily. This project's expected date was 2026-07-25 and it arrived unmet

retinue#39, filed 2026-07-27 04:58:33 UTC (12 h 45 m at this stamp), is the newest issue anywhere in the org and is two findings in one: each of two services assumes the /tmp lifetime the other one has. signal-gateway loses the queue of verify-category outbound messages on the documented update path, silently, after signal-push.py has already reported them queued for approval; qlever-static rebuilds its index from a stale cached decompression on the documented reindex recipe and reports 'Index built.' The only shipped example configuration is the affected one. Both are one-line fixes in opposite directions - give signal-gateway's /tmp a volume, or stop caching by existence

Three issues from 2026-07-26 are still unseen - retinue#36, #37, #38, opened 02:02:38, 02:39:49 and 03:17:00 UTC that day (1 d 15 h, 1 d 15 h and 1 d 14 h at this stamp). #37 first: git-serialize.sh, the shim two agents rely on to not clobber each other, matches 'git commit' but not 'git -C <repo> commit', and the second form is what the web gateway's own auto-commit uses, so the framework's principal caller of the lock bypasses it. #36: the three push CLIs' --help describes the send policy as a property of the recipient, while the gateways, the tests and four docs key it to the sending identity - and that help text is what an agent reads while deciding whether to claim a send was approved. #38: the two shipped example chamber agents assert a chamber confinement SECURITY.md lists as a known limitation, in the files examples/chambers/README.md calls the canonical authoring reference

Triage the remaining defects in the indexing mechanism the lead story rests on - qlever-dir#8 (blank nodes collide across files; you proposed skolemizing per graph on 2026-07-25 and Aros answered the same day, latest comment 2026-07-26 10:18 UTC) opened 2026-07-23 15:52:25 UTC, 4 d 1 h at this stamp, and #10 (a directory created after startup is never watched, which is exactly how the framework's own boot emitters write) opened 2026-07-24 16:49:56 UTC, 3 d 0 h. #9 in that set is closed - filed 2026-07-23 15:53:04 UTC, merged 2026-07-25 15:14:15 UTC, 47 h - and its fix is verified here against a fixture covering five symlink shapes

retinue#2 needs a decision rather than a merge - opened 2026-07-19 23:18:06 UTC, 7 d 18 h at this stamp. Its branch docs/calibrate-reindex-latency replaces the docs' '~15 s' with '15-20 s for a small file', and that number is stale: re-measured 2026-07-25 in this deployment it is 20-25 s over three trials with no code change, because the chamber grew from 340 KB to 1.4 MB. Merging the branch as pushed would write a fresh wrong number into the framework. The replacement wording, with method and bounds, is in a comment from 2026-07-25 20:36 UTC. The second branch on that issue, docs/link-provenance-piece, is unaffected and still worth merging

retinue#28 is on main rather than on a branch - opened 2026-07-24 16:50:49 UTC, 3 d 0 h at this stamp: PR #22 merged 2026-07-25 15:12 UTC with both items unaddressed - docs/triple-stores.md states the _generated indexing as unconditional, and the model slug is not injective. Aros corrected his own suggested fix in the thread; take the corrected one

review.md is stale on tests and CI: recommendation #2 is done and six statements in it were made false by that - retinue#3, opened 2026-07-20 04:24:05 UTC, 7 d 13 h at this stamp. Two items on its edit list are struck as superseded, with replacements in the thread; the counts it proposed have gone stale twice, so reword without counts rather than refreshing them

Nothing new will arrive here before 2026-07-28 04:58 UTC, and that is a rule rather than a lull: one new issue per 24 hours while nothing is inbound and the queue is above 20 open. Four findings are written up in full and waiting - the held count was five at the two previous generations and was corrected to four at 2026-07-27 14:26 UTC, when the classifier producing it turned out to match a format rather than a claim. The oldest was committed 2026-07-26 06:25:38 UTC (1 d 11 h at this stamp); they sit in drafts/ in this chamber, readable now, each stating whether it was filed and where. If you would rather see findings as they are found, say so and the limit goes
